_readme: A verified, working Nim.video provider definition for RenderPost's aggregator framework (see docs/BEHAVIOR_MAP.md §3.11 and the 'Connect providers' settings panel). This exact definition ships built into RenderPost.py's PROVIDERS dict — this file exists as a readable reference and as a template for adding another provider the same way. Every endpoint, field name and response shape here was confirmed live against the real Nim.video MCP server on 2026-10-03 (Dynamic Client Registration via a direct unauthenticated HTTP request, a real image edit, and a real image-to-video generation — not guessed from documentation or assumed from Higgsfield's shape, which differs in three real ways: no import-by-URL, a flat fileInputs array instead of role-tagged objects, and a multi-valued terminal status). Uses mcp_http so generation draws on an existing Nim.video subscription's credit pool.

verified_2026-10-03: Dynamic Client Registration against https://mcp.nim.video/api/mcp/oauth/register — plain unauthenticated POST, returns a client_id immediately; its own response (and the /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server metadata) report grant_types: ["authorization_code"] only, no refresh_token grant, unlike Higgsfield

No import-by-URL tool exists — a bare remote URL in fileInputs fails with error_code generation_unavailable. Real mechanism: media_upload (no arguments) returns {upload_url, method, expires_at} (~10 minute token in the query string); a plain multipart/form-data POST (field name "file") to that URL returns {file_id, file_url, type, content_type, status}
Minimum upload size is 300x300px — a 100x100 test image was rejected with a clear 400 before any credits were spent

generate_image/generate_video response once queued: {workflowId, promptId, status: "queued", estimatedCreditCost, ...} — poll get_generation_status with {workflowId} until status reaches one of finished/failed/cancelled/removed; result image/video is in mediaUrl
Nano Banana Pro Edit (geminiNanoBananaV2Consistency): 25 credits at 2K, real generation completed end to end

GPT Image 2.5 Flare Medium (runwareOpenaiGptImage25FlareConsistencyMedium): 8 credits actual charge (Nim's own note: base price plus ~2 credits/megapixel of reference images), real generation completed end to end. The plain, non-"runware"-prefixed GPT Image Editing family (gptConsistencyLow/High) failed with generation_unavailable even with a confirmed-good upload — avoid it

Hailuo 2.3 Fast (falMinimaxHailuo2.3FastStandardImage2Video): 30 credits for a 6s clip, real generation completed end to end. Only allows durationsMs [6000, 10000]; forbids both "resolution" and "requestedAspectRatio" entirely — sending either may be rejected

Seedance 2.5 (seedanceV25ImageToVideo): 250 credits at the default 5s/720p per its own models_explore price estimate (50 credits/second) — parameters confirmed via its generationContract, but NOT run through an actual generation this session (cost exceeded the remaining per-session spend authorization)
not_verified: Seedance 2.5's actual generation behavior (only its live-fetched schema/price was checked, not a real run)
Per-resolution pricing for Seedance 2.5 at 480p/1080p (only the 720p default price point was exposed by models_explore)
Hailuo 2.3 Fast's price at its other allowed duration (10s) — only the 6s default was priced

Two-reference-image requests (character reference) specifically for Nim — the conditional upload/fileInputs path reuses the same mechanism verified with one reference, but hasn't itself been run with two
GPT Image 2.5 Flare/Sunburst at Low/High quality tiers — only Medium was run; each quality tier is a distinct model_id on Nim, unlike Higgsfield's single adjustable quality parameter
